nodes.title: Edition B: bearings and alignment
nodes.summary: This section introduces the fundamentals of pump maintenance, concentrating on bearings and alignment as presented in Edition B. It explains why proper bearing condition and accurate alignment are essential for reliable pump operation.
objectives: Identify key components of pump maintenance
Explain the role of bearings and alignment in pump performance

nodes.title: Grease quantity matters
nodes.summary: The section focuses on bearing lubrication, emphasizing the importance of applying the correct amount of grease. It describes how excessive grease can increase bearing temperature.
objectives: Explain the effect of over‑greasing on temperature

nodes.title: Dial indicator method
nodes.summary: This section covers shaft alignment techniques, presenting the dial‑indicator method, laser alignment, and the prerequisite soft‑foot check. It compares manual and laser approaches and stresses checking soft foot before alignment.

Compare dial‑indicator and laser alignment techniques
Conduct a soft‑foot check prior to alignment

nodes.title: Alignment Tolerances
nodes.summary: The section outlines alignment tolerance limits based on pump rotational speed, providing a table of acceptable offset values for typical speeds.

properties.heading: Edition B: bearings and alignment
properties.text:
Edition B: bearings and alignment

This section introduces the fundamentals of pump maintenance, concentrating on bearings and alignment as presented in Edition B. It explains why proper bearing condition and accurate alignment are essential for reliable pump operation.

Objectives:
- Identify key components of pump maintenance
- Explain the role of bearings and alignment in pump performance

properties.heading: Grease quantity matters
properties.text:
Grease quantity matters

The section focuses on bearing lubrication, emphasizing the importance of applying the correct amount of grease. It describes how excessive grease can increase bearing temperature.

Objectives:
- Describe proper bearing lubrication practices
- Explain the effect of over‑greasing on temperature

properties.heading: Dial indicator method
properties.text:
Dial indicator method

This section covers shaft alignment techniques, presenting the dial‑indicator method, laser alignment, and the prerequisite soft‑foot check. It compares manual and laser approaches and stresses checking soft foot before alignment.

Objectives:
- Perform shaft alignment using the dial‑indicator method
- Compare dial‑indicator and laser alignment techniques
- Conduct a soft‑foot check prior to alignment

properties.heading: Alignment Tolerances
properties.text:
Alignment Tolerances

The section outlines alignment tolerance limits based on pump rotational speed, providing a table of acceptable offset values for typical speeds.

Objectives:
- Determine the appropriate alignment tolerance for a given speed
- Read and interpret alignment tolerance tables
